name: Booz Scooters
tagline: Ahmedabad electric kick-scooter fleet for campuses and gated communities
excerpt: Booz Scooters, an Ahmedabad electric scooter rental business, pitched in the very first episode of Shark Tank India.
content:
Booz runs fleets of electric kick scooters for short trips inside private spaces such as campuses and gated communities. Founder Rutvij Dasadia pitched it in the first episode of Shark Tank India, aired on 20 December 2021, asking for ₹40 lakh for 15%.

Accounts of the final deal disagree, and none comes from an outlet we rely on, so we do not state the outcome.

The business continues as Booz Mobility. In September 2024 it signed a partnership with EMotorad, which became the exclusive supplier of kick scooters for its fleet.

faq.q: What did Booz ask for on Shark Tank India?
faq.a: ₹40 lakh for 15% of the company, in Season 1, Episode 1.
Yes, as Booz Mobility; it announced a scooter supply partnership with EMotorad in September 2024.

lessons: Our analysis: a narrow, controlled operating area (campuses, gated communities) makes shared micro-mobility easier to run than open streets.
notes: BELOW PUBLISHING BAR: deal.made not sourced. Wikipedia lists ₹40 lakh for 50% with Ashneer Grover and Vineeta Singh; StartupWired gives different terms and founders. No credible outlet found. Website not confirmed. Swap candidate.
